text: Please accept this letter as my request to add a new item of business onto the Scarborough Community Council agenda which is parking regulations on Bluefin Crescent and Dolly Varden Boulevard. I am asking for your support for the following motion: That Council create a no parking regulation from 2:00 a.m. to 5:00 a.m., from December 01 to April 01, on Bluefin Crescent and Dolly Varden Boulevard. If you have any questions regarding this matter please feel free to contact me at 416-392-0204.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Requested the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District, to report back to the February 21, 2018 meeting of the Scarborough Community Council on parking prohibitions on Bluefin Crescent and Dolly Varden Boulevard.
